description: Manage SimplyMeet.me meetings, meeting types, scheduling links, tags and polls.

simplymeet_me_new_meeting_trigger.description: Runs when new meeting is observed in SimplyMeet.me. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

simplymeet_me_new_meeting_type_trigger.description: Runs when new meeting type is observed in SimplyMeet.me. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

simplymeet_me_new_or_updated_meeting_tri.description: Runs when new or updated meeting is observed in SimplyMeet.me. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

simplymeet_me_new_or_updated_meeting_typ.description: Runs when new or updated meeting type is observed in SimplyMeet.me. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

simplymeet_me_new_or_updated_poll_trigge.description: Runs when new or updated poll is observed in SimplyMeet.me. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

simplymeet_me_new_poll_trigger.description: Runs when new poll is observed in SimplyMeet.me. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.
